evaluator.value: function value(v,st){if(v.type==="VARIABLE_ALIAS")return st[v.value.id];if(v.type!=="EXPRESSION")return v.value;const e=v.value,args=e.expressionArguments.map(x=>value(x,st));switch(e.expressionFunction){case "EQUALS":return args[0]===args[1];case "AND":return args.every(Boolean);case "OR":return args.some(Boolean);default:throw Error(e.expressionFunction)}}
evaluator.run: function run(id,st={}){const state={...st},events=[];const act=arr=>{for(const x of arr){if(x.type==="CONDITIONAL"){for(const b of x.conditionalBlocks){if(!b.condition||value(b.condition,state)){act(b.actions);break}}}else if(x.type==="SET_VARIABLE")state[x.variableId]=value(x.variableValue,state);else events.push(x)}};for(const r of by[id].reactions||[])act(r.actions);return {state,events}}
